turns.speaker: user
turns.text: How do I pick a good vet? We've just moved here.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ask neighbours with pets and check local reviews. Then ring a couple of practices and see how they treat you on the phone.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Ask about out of hours emergencies, whether they have a vet that likes cats or exotics if you need that, and how easy appointments are to get.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got a rabbit and a dog.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then check they're comfortable with rabbits, not every vet is. Some practices have a special interest in them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I register now even if no one's sick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes, do it now. It's much less stressful than trying to find one in an emergency at midnight.
